description: U-Net 2020 FoM recomputed with eval_mask = (counts>0) & (gt_2020>0.01), matching the CNN and ConvLSTM 2020 evaluation domain exactly. Original unet_2020_holdout.json used DataLoader (all val-tile pixels, 13.4M pixels, 4.0% growth). This recomputation uses 1,574,225 pixels, 10.57% growth — identical domain to CNN/ConvLSTM.
